items_all.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
items_all.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。

items_all.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. items_all.title: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
items_all.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
items_all_raw.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。
